drafts.walkScript: Start with broad. Find the word that could swap places with it. Wide means the same as broad, so wide fits. Narrow is its opposite. Long and tall describe size in another way.
Start with moist. Find the word that could swap places with it. Damp means the same, a little wet. Dry is its opposite. Warm and soft describe things, but not how wet they are.
Start with foolish. Find the word that could swap places with it. Silly means the same as foolish. Sensible is its opposite. Young and brave describe people, but mean something else.
Start with leap. Find the word that could swap places with it. Jump means the same as leap. Dance and run are other ways to move. Land is what comes after a leap.
Start with grab. Find the word that could swap places with it. Seize means the same, to take hold of. Release is its opposite. Pull and go are different actions.
Start with finish. Find the word that could swap places with it. End means the same as finish. Begin is its opposite. Win and the last option go with finishing, but mean something else.
Start with build. Find the word that could swap places with it. Construct means the same as build. Demolish is its opposite. Hammer and plan go with building, but do not mean it.
Start with old. Find the word that could swap places with it. Elderly means the same as old. Young is its opposite. Good and wise describe a person in other ways.
Start with rich. Find the word that could swap places with it. Wealthy means the same as rich. Penniless is its opposite. Famous and powerful often go with rich, but mean something else.
Start with brave. Find the word that could swap places with it. Courageous means the same as brave. Timid is its opposite. Loyal and kind describe a person in other ways.
Start with tired. Find the word that could swap places with it. Weary means the same as tired. Lively is its opposite. Hungry and grumpy are other feelings.
Start with happy. Find the word that could swap places with it. Glad means the same as happy. Gloomy is its opposite. Healthy and friendly describe a person in other ways.
Start with help. Find the word that could swap places with it. Assist means the same as help. Hinder is its opposite. Thank and share are different actions.
Start with choose. Find the word that could swap places with it. Select means the same as choose. Refuse means to say no. Buy and answer are different actions.
Start with odd. Strange means the same as odd, so it could swap places with it. Ordinary is its opposite. Even is the opposite of odd in numbers. Puzzled is a feeling.
Start with gift. Find the word that could swap places with it. Present means the same as gift. Birthday, ribbon and card go with a gift, but mean something else.
Start with speak. Find the word that could swap places with it. Talk means the same as speak. Shout means speak very loudly, so it is too strong. Listen and write are different actions.
Start with begin. Find the word that could swap places with it. Start means the same as begin. Finish is its opposite. Race and count are things that can begin.
Start with shut. Close means the same as shut, so it could swap places with it. Open is its opposite. Slam means shut hard, so it is too strong. Sleep is something else.
Start with big. Find the word that could swap places with it. Large means the same as big. Small is its opposite. Slow and heavy describe things in other ways.
Start with the word on the card. Find the word that could swap places with it. Rapid means fast, so it means the same. Slow is its opposite. Quiet and the other option do not mean fast.
Start with scared. Find the word that could swap places with it. Fearful means the same as scared. Bold is its opposite. Dark and alone can make someone scared, but mean something else.
Start with angry. Find the word that could swap places with it. Cross means the same as angry. Calm is its opposite. Red and loud can go with angry, but mean something else.
Start with silent. Find the word that could swap places with it. Quiet means the same as silent. Noisy is its opposite. Dark and empty describe a place in other ways.
Start with the word on the card. Look for the option that means not hard. Tricky means hard, so it is the opposite. Short and fun mean something else. The option left means the same as the card word.
